描述_ZN: The full title of "Jingjun Stele" is "Inscription of Jingjun, the late Han Dynasty Minister of the North Sea", in official script, 230 cm high. It is 17 lines high, with 33 characters; 4 columns in the shade, 18 lines in each of the upper 3 columns, and 2 lines in the 4th column. The end of the epigraph is in 2 lines, with 42 characters. Erected in the third year of Han's reign (144). The front of the stele is inscribed in seal script in Yang dynasty, "Inscription of Jingjun, the former governor of Yizhou in the Han Dynasty, inscribed in Beihai," with 12 characters in 2 lines. The upper part of the stele is pierced with two characters in each of the eighth, ninth and tenth lines. The monument was built after the death of Beihai Xiangjingjun, the governor of Yizhou, by his disciples and former officials who admired his merits and virtues. The monument is now in Jining, Shandong Province.　　This is a Ming topography, the tablet is Yang, framed and mounted, 199.7 cm in length (including the front of the tablet) and 77.8 cm in width. It is heavily inked. Fuzhai inscription, the upper right side of the Tie Daoist (Mao Huai) trek a paragraph of inscription, "big section of ink stone writing", "Yanzu longevity" and other four seals. The eleventh line "merchant empty market" of the word "city" survives the left half, the eighth line "remnants of false and easy heart" of the word "remnants" The character "残" in the eighth line, "残伪易心", remains undamaged. The topography is excellent, and although the stone is lax, the viewer can still appreciate the beauty of its calligraphy. It was originally collected by Zhu Yi Container and later donated to the National Palace Museum.　　The calligraphy of the "Jingjun Stele" is unique in that it is written with a square brush, with a slight variation in the meaning of seal script, and with a sharp edge in the closing strokes. Wang Shizhen of the Ming Dynasty commented on the calligraphy: "The calligraphy is so elegant since ancient times." Sun Chengze of the Qing dynasty said, "The square and neat characters are divided." 　　Song Ouyang Xiu "collection of ancient records of the end", Zhao Mingcheng "Jinshilu", Hong Shi "official release", Ming Du Mu "gold scallion Linlang", Qing Sun Chengze "Gengzi pin summer record", Ma Ziyun, Shi Anchang "stele identification" and other books are recorded.
